comparison.objective: Place two detergent tablets in the main-wash compartment and close the drawer, versus tang fracture and recovery.
comparison.physical_skill: Tablet placement and articulated-drawer closure versus coaxial tool control, impact loading, fracture, and fragment retrieval.
comparison.success_condition: Both tablets correctly compartmentalized and drawer shut versus four tangs fractured and contained with the assembly undamaged. Detailed thresholds are absent.
comparison.reason: This is dosing and drawer operation, not controlled fracture of installed fastener features.
